title: The Lord of the Rings
synopsis: A humble hobbit inherits a powerful ring and joins a fellowship on a perilous journey across Middle-earth to destroy it before the Dark Lord Sauron can conquer the world.
subtitle: One ring. One journey. One last chance.

direction.subject: A weathered hobbit figure clutching a glowing golden ring, representing the burden of the journey.
direction.setting: The dark, craggy landscapes of Middle-earth with a distant, glowing volcano under a stormy, epic sky.
direction.mood: Epic, perilous, and atmospheric high fantasy with a sense of immense scale.
motifs: The One Ring with faint glowing inscriptions
The silhouette of a dark tower
direction.palette: A high-contrast mix of volcanic oranges, deep obsidian blacks, and cold slate greys.
direction.composition: Cinematic wide-angle shots with a focus on scale; low-angle shots for the subject to emphasize the weight of the quest.
continuity_rules: The Ring must emit a soft, warm golden light
Atmospheric fog and embers are present in all scenes
direction.cover_prompt: A cinematic 16:9 wide shot of a lone traveler in a tattered cloak standing on a rocky precipice overlooking the dark land of Mordor. A distant volcano erupts with soft orange light. The title 'The Lord of the Rings' is elegantly integrated into the dark clouds in a gold-etched, serif font. High-detail fantasy art, moody lighting, epic scale.
direction.thumbnail_prompt: A high-impact 16:9 YouTube thumbnail featuring a close-up of a hand holding the glowing One Ring. In the blurred background, a flaming eye looms over a dark tower. Bold, prominent 3D gold text reads 'The Lord of the Rings'. Directly underneath, in a smaller secondary font, reads the subtitle: 'One ring. One journey. One last chance.' Vibrant contrast, saturated oranges and blacks, hyper-realistic detail.
